_comment: The director's fixed menu. Every shot in a plan picks from these ids; the checker refuses anything else. `words` is how a prompt says it; `hailuo` is MiniMax Hailuo's bracket command where one exists. The craft behind each entry is in skills/motion-design/references/director/craft.md.

sizes.label: Extreme wide
sizes.when: Show the whole world and how small the subject is in it; opens a film or a new place.

sizes.label: Wide
sizes.when: Establish the place and where everyone is before going closer.

sizes.label: Full
sizes.when: The whole body, head to toe; movement, posture and costume.

sizes.label: Medium wide
sizes.when: Knees up; a person and what their hands and surroundings are doing.

sizes.label: Medium
sizes.when: Waist up; the neutral conversational shot.

sizes.label: Two-shot
sizes.when: Two people in one frame, usually knees or waist up; conversations and relationships.

sizes.label: Medium close-up
sizes.when: Chest up; reactions while keeping a little context.

sizes.label: Close-up
sizes.when: The face or the object fills the frame; emotion and decisions.

sizes.label: Extreme close-up
sizes.when: An eye, a fingertip, a texture; maximum intensity, used sparingly.

sizes.label: Insert
sizes.when: A detail the viewer must read: a screen, a button, a label.

angles.label: High
angles.when: Looking down makes the subject smaller or overwhelmed.

angles.label: Low
angles.when: Looking up makes the subject powerful or heroic.

angles.label: Overhead
angles.when: Straight down; desks, layouts, screens treated as graphics.

angles.label: Worm's eye
angles.when: From the floor; scale and drama.

angles.label: Dutch
angles.when: A tilted horizon for unease or energy; rarely, never twice in a row.

angles.label: Over the shoulder
angles.when: Past one person to another person or a screen; puts the viewer in the scene.

lenses.label: 14mm ultra-wide
lenses.when: Exaggerated space for tight interiors and energy; never on a face up close.

lenses.label: 24mm wide
lenses.when: Roomy and close at once; establishing shots and moving through space.

lenses.label: 35mm
lenses.when: Natural and documentary; the storyteller's all-rounder.

lenses.label: 50mm
lenses.when: Close to how the eye sees; honest medium shots.

lenses.label: 85mm portrait
lenses.when: Flatters faces and melts the background; close-ups.

lenses.label: 135mm telephoto
lenses.when: Compresses the background and isolates; watching from afar.

lenses.label: 100mm macro
lenses.when: Tiny details large and sharp; textures, product surfaces, UI pixels.

lensLooks.label: Clean sharp
lensLooks.when: A clean modern look with round bokeh.

lensLooks.label: Anamorphic
lensLooks.when: A cinematic widescreen feel with oval bokeh and horizontal flares.

lensLooks.label: Halation vintage
lensLooks.when: A dreamy, nostalgic glow around lights and bright skin.

lensLooks.label: Warm vintage
lensLooks.when: Gentle, warm and forgiving; memories, lifestyle, food.

lensLooks.label: Vintage anamorphic
lensLooks.when: Seventies widescreen: blue streak flares and imperfect edges.

cameras.label: DV camcorder
cameras.words: shot on a 2000s DV camcorder, soft video detail, noise and clipped highlights
cameras.when: Home video, found footage, Y2K nostalgia.

cameras.label: 8mm film
cameras.words: shot on grainy Super 8 film with gate weave and faded warm colour
cameras.when: Memories, travel diaries and dreamy montages.

cameras.label: 35mm film
cameras.words: shot on 35mm film with fine grain and rich, natural colour
cameras.when: Classic cinema: drama, fashion, anything that should feel filmed.

cameras.label: Modern
cameras.words: shot on a modern digital cinema camera, clean and sharp
cameras.when: Crisp commercial work, tech and products.

depths.label: f/1.4 Wide open
depths.when: One plane sharp, the rest soft; isolates the subject.

depths.label: f/11 Deep focus
depths.when: Everything sharp; wide shots and graphic layouts.

moves.label: Static shot
moves.words: holds still
moves.when: Let the action or the composition do the work.

moves.label: Dolly in
moves.words: pushes in
moves.when: Move toward the subject to build attention or a realisation.

moves.label: Dolly out
moves.words: pulls out
moves.when: Move away to reveal context or close a scene.

moves.label: Pan left
moves.words: stays fixed in one spot facing the subject, starts turned to the right of them where they are out of frame, and rotates left on the spot until they sit in the centre
moves.when: Turn on the spot to find or reveal the subject: it starts off to their side and swings onto them.

moves.label: Pan right
moves.words: stays fixed in one spot facing the subject, starts turned to the left of them where they are out of frame, and rotates right on the spot until they sit in the centre
moves.when: Turn on the spot to find or reveal the subject: it starts off to their side and swings onto them.

moves.label: Tilt up
moves.words: starts below waist height pointing at the ground and tilts up on the spot, without rising, to reveal the subject
moves.when: Reveal a figure from the ground up, or lift the mood.

moves.label: Tilt down
moves.words: starts a little above head height pointing up and tilts down on the spot, without lowering, to reveal the subject from above
moves.when: Bring the eye down to what matters.

moves.label: Truck left
moves.words: trucks left after the subject, starting late as they turn and walk off in profile, and catching up until they are back in the centre
moves.when: The subject leads and the camera catches up: a sideways slide with parallax that starts late.

moves.label: Truck right
moves.words: trucks right after the subject, starting late as they turn and walk off in profile, and catching up until they are back in the centre
moves.when: The subject leads and the camera catches up: a sideways slide with parallax that starts late.

moves.label: Pedestal up
moves.words: rises straight up
moves.when: Lift without tilting to reveal over an object.

moves.label: Pedestal down
moves.words: lowers straight down
moves.when: Sink without tilting to land on a detail.

moves.label: Tracking
moves.words: follows the subject
moves.when: Stay with a moving subject at a constant distance.

moves.label: Arc left
moves.words: orbits left around the subject
moves.when: Circle the subject to show it in the round; keep the arc under 45 degrees.

moves.label: Arc right
moves.words: orbits right around the subject
moves.when: Circle the subject to show it in the round; keep the arc under 45 degrees.

moves.label: Crane up
moves.words: starts at the subject's waist height with their full body in frame and rises steadily up and back along a curve, tilting down to keep them centred, until it looks down on them from far above
moves.when: A big rising move away from the subject for openings and endings: they shrink as the space opens up.

moves.label: Crane down
moves.words: starts far above looking steeply down on the subject and descends steadily down and forward along a curve, tilting up to keep them centred, until it is at their waist height with their full body in frame
moves.when: Descend into the scene from above.

moves.label: Handheld
moves.words: moves handheld with a slight natural shake
moves.when: Immediacy: creator footage, documentary.

moves.label: Slow zoom in
moves.words: zooms in
moves.when: Magnify without moving; a flat, deliberate emphasis.

moves.label: Slow zoom out
moves.words: zooms out
moves.when: Shrink the view without moving.

moves.label: Dolly zoom
moves.words: pushes in while zooming out so the background stretches
moves.when: A sudden realisation or vertigo; once per film at most.

moves.label: Aerial
moves.words: flies over the scene from high above like a drone
moves.when: Open on a landscape, a city or a route; geography at scale.

moves.label: Rack focus
moves.words: holds still while the focus shifts from the subject to an object close to the lens, each blurring as the other sharpens
moves.when: Shift attention between two planes without moving: a subject and something close to the lens.

moves.label: Side tracking
moves.words: moves sideways exactly with the walking subject from the first moment, keeping them in profile dead centre
moves.when: Run beside a walking or running subject, locked dead centre; the background streams past.

moves.label: Slider left
moves.words: starts on the subject and glides smoothly sideways to the left, near pillars passing with parallax, until the subject slides out of frame on the right
moves.when: A smooth sideways glide away from the subject, with parallax: products, details, calm portraits, an exit.

moves.label: Slider right
moves.words: starts on the subject and glides smoothly sideways to the right, near pillars passing with parallax, until the subject slides out of frame on the left
moves.when: A smooth sideways glide away from the subject, with parallax: products, details, calm portraits, an exit.

moves.label: Snorricam
moves.words: is strapped to the subject's waist facing up at them, so every step jolts and shakes it and every turn of their body swings it the same way, while the world lurches past behind them
moves.when: A walk felt from inside the body: they stay pinned in frame, the world shakes and swings. Panic, drunkenness or resolve.

moves.label: Robot arm
moves.words: moves like a robotic arm in precise beats: from the subject's feet it swirls up and around at a steady, unhurried pace, easing back a little, to face them and holds, then pivots up and over to look down on their head from above and holds
moves.when: High-energy product and fashion hero moments: close, machine-precise moves that snap between held angles.

moves.label: POV
moves.words: moves as the subject's own eyes, in first person
moves.when: Put the viewer inside the character: walking, reaching, looking around.

moves.label: Whip pan
moves.words: whips sideways in a fast blurred pan
moves.when: Snap attention to something new, or bridge two shots with energy.

moves.label: Crash zoom
moves.words: zooms in fast from a wide view toward the subject's face, easing to a stop with their eyes dead centre, and holds
moves.when: A sudden, punchy emphasis: a reaction, a reveal, a comic beat.

moves.label: Bullet time
moves.words: faces the subject as they jump, freezes them in mid-air with hair and clothes suspended, holds a beat, then circles around the frozen moment close to them
moves.when: One frozen peak moment seen in the round; use once.

moves.label: Drone orbit
moves.words: circles the subject from high above like an orbiting drone
moves.when: Show a lone figure or a place inside its landscape.

moves.label: Helicopter shot
moves.words: flies high and fast over the landscape like a helicopter shot
moves.when: Epic scale: open over a city, a coastline or mountains.

moves.label: Aerial pullback
moves.words: pulls back and rises into the sky, leaving the subject small below
moves.when: Close a film: the character becomes small in a big world.

speeds.label: Creep
speeds.when: Barely perceptible movement; product hero and tension.

speeds.label: Fast
speeds.when: Energy and urgency; needs room, so not in short shots.

palettes.label: Silver noon
palettes.words: black and white: deep inky blacks, silver greys and soft paper whites, no colour
palettes.when: Classic, stark, timeless; music videos and fashion.

palettes.label: Teal and amber
palettes.words: teal shadows and warm amber skin and highlights, rich contrast
palettes.when: Blockbuster polish; action, night streets, anything heroic.

palettes.label: Neon night
palettes.words: deep blue-black night with hot magenta and electric cyan neon, saturated

palettes.label: Forest mist
palettes.words: mossy greens, cool foggy grey-greens and dark bark browns, soft and damp

palettes.label: Desert highway
palettes.words: sun-bleached tans and dusty ochre against a hard blue sky, rusty reds
palettes.when: Westerns, road trips, heat and dust.

palettes.label: Seventies Kodak
palettes.words: warm 1970s film colours: burnt orange, chocolate brown, mustard and olive, faded blacks

palettes.label: Pastel shop
palettes.words: soft creams, sage green, blush pink and pale wood, low contrast and airy
palettes.when: Gentle romance, lifestyle, cosy shops and cafés.

palettes.label: Fluorescent yellow
palettes.words: sickly mustard yellows and damp olive under flat white fluorescent light, dull and uneasy
palettes.when: Liminal spaces, offices after hours, unease.

palettes.label: Rose station
palettes.words: dusty rose and candy pinks with cream and soft burgundy, symmetrical and storybook
palettes.when: Whimsy, fairy-tale cities, playful period pieces.

palettes.label: Blue hour
palettes.words: cold dusk blues and steel greys with a few warm window lights, quiet and melancholic

palettes.label: Bleach bypass
palettes.words: desaturated steel and gunmetal with crushed blacks and harsh silvery highlights, high contrast

palettes.label: Golden hour
palettes.words: low warm sun: honey gold, peach and soft orange with long brown shadows

lights.label: Soft high key
lights.when: Bright and friendly with little shadow; tech and lifestyle.

lights.label: Window light
lights.words: soft directional daylight from a window
lights.when: Interiors that should feel real; the usual live-action key.

lights.label: Low key
lights.words: moody low-key light with deep shadows

lights.label: Rembrandt
lights.words: Rembrandt lighting with a triangle of light on the shadow cheek

lights.label: Backlit rim
lights.words: backlight that rims the subject in light
lights.when: Separates the subject from the background; silhouettes and hair light.

lights.label: Blue hour
lights.words: cool blue-hour twilight with warm practical lights
lights.when: Just after sunset; calm, wistful, cinematic city and coast.

lights.label: Night with practicals
lights.words: night scene lit by practical lamps and screens
lights.when: Lamps, signs and screens in frame are the light.

lights.label: Studio product
lights.words: studio product lighting with a large softbox and a rim light
lights.when: Clean reflections and crisp edges on products.

lights.label: Overcast natural
lights.when: Natural and gentle with no hard shadows.

lights.label: Hard midday sun
lights.words: hard midday sun with crisp, short shadows
lights.when: Heat, summer, energy, sport; bold graphic shadows.

cuts.label: Jump cut
cuts.when: Deliberate jumps in time within one framing; creator and UGC energy.

cuts.label: Cut on action
cuts.when: Cut mid-movement so the motion hides the edit.

cuts.label: Match cut
cuts.when: A shape or motion here matches one in the next shot.

cuts.label: Whip pan
cuts.when: A fast blur carries the energy into the next shot.

cuts.label: Dissolve
cuts.when: Time passes, or a soft change of mood.

cuts.label: Fade to black
cuts.when: End a film or a chapter; the last shot only, or before a title.

cuts.label: Continuous
cuts.when: The next shot starts on this shot's last frame: one unbroken moment.

keyLightSides.label: Front
keyLightSides.when: Flat and even; graphics and beauty.

keyLightSides.label: Top
keyLightSides.when: Overhead light; product tables and drama.

jobs.label: Motion graphics
jobs.when: Type, UI and abstract graphic motion.

jobs.label: Cinematic
jobs.when: Live-action-looking scenes with people and places.

jobs.label: Working from reference images
jobs.when: A Library character or product must match its sheet.

jobs.label: Lip sync
jobs.when: Someone speaks a line on camera.

jobs.label: Product hero
jobs.when: Physical products on turntables, in macro and under light sweeps.

filmTypes.label: Product ad with UI
filmTypes.when: App screens, a mascot, kinetic type and an end card.

filmTypes.label: Character animation
filmTypes.when: Stylised or 3D characters acting out a short story.

filmTypes.label: Product hero
filmTypes.when: A physical product shown at its best.
